integrity: The theorem is proved by exact 2x2 integer-matrix algebra; bounded computation was used only as a sanity check and not as proof.
limitations: The criterion excludes the singular locus n^2=bc and concerns elementary, not arbitrary-length, strong shift equivalence. Historical novelty is subject to the residual risk of unindexed or folklore observations.
title: Exact one-step strong-shift-equivalence criterion for a diagonal generalized Baker family
